title: Problems Around Polynomials — Conjecture 10
exact_target: Does the parity-change count among indices with nonnegative ordinary coefficient differences bound the number of real roots?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2200015 (AMR-021-0015). CC BY 4.0.
